messages.text: Those fixes are in. I’m rerunning the same official comparisons now, then I’ll expand into select/search/sort/frequency/stats edge cases from the Rust tests.

commands.commandLine:
"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command "@'
import subprocess, pathlib, sys, tempfile
root=pathlib.Path.cwd(); ref=pathlib.Path(root/'REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip(); py=[sys.executable,str(root/'executable')]
def run(cmd,cwd): return subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=cwd,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
def case(name,files,args):
  with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    d=pathlib.Path(td)
    for fn,txt in files.items(): (d/fn).write_text(txt,encoding='utf-8',newline='')
    r=run([ref]+args,d); p=run(py+args,d)
    if (r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)"'!=(p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr):
      print('"'FAIL',name,args); print(r.returncode,p.returncode); print(repr(r.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'))); print(repr(p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace'))); print(repr(r.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace'))); print(repr(p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace'))); return False
    print('ok',name); return True
cases=[
('headers', {'in.csv':'h1,h2\\na,b\\n'}, ['headers','in.csv']),('count', {'in.csv':'h1,h2\\na,b\\n'}, ['count','in.csv']),('select', {'data.csv':'h1,h2,h[]3,h4,h1\\na,b,c,d,e\\n'}, ['select','h1[1]-h1[0]','data.csv']),('slice', {'in.csv':'header\\na\\nb\\nc\\nd\\ne\\n'}, ['slice','--start','1','--end','3','in.csv']),('search', {'data.csv':'h1,h2\\nfoobar,barfoo\\na,b\\nbarfoo,foobar\\n'}, ['search','"'^foo'"','data.csv']),('sortN', {'in.csv':'N,S\\n10,a\\nLETTER,b\\n2,c\\n1,d\\n'}, ['sort','-N','in.csv']),('table', {'in.csv':'h1,h2,h3\\nabcdefg,a,a\\na,abc,z\\n'}, ['table','in.csv']),('fmt', {'in.csv':'h1,h2\\nabcdef,ghijkl\\nmnopqr,stuvwx\\n'}, ['fmt','--out-delimiter','h','in.csv']),('freq', {'in.csv':'h1,h2\\na,z\\na,y\\na,y\\nb,z\\n,z\\n(NULL),x\\n'}, ['frequency','--limit','0','--select','h1','in.csv']),('stats', {'in.csv':'header\\n1\\n2\\n3\\n'}, ['stats','--median','--mode','--cardinality','in.csv']),]
ok=True
for c in cases: ok=case(*c) and ok
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
'@ | python -"
